pa_scenario_qa_pairs.question: Chitti, thore sngatho-ne chosting 6 la nga skong bcos.
pa_scenario_qa_pairs.answer: Jullay! Thore sngatho-ne chosting 6 la nga khyog skong bcos. Sngatho-ne khams-zang dang nam-zang khyog la skrag-mo yong!

pa_scenario_qa_pairs.question: Sman thung-ches tshad-ma-zhig song-nga?
pa_scenario_qa_pairs.answer: Hoi Jullay, sman thung-ches tshad-ma song. Lus-po bzang-po ma-song-na thams-cad med. Da-lto thung-ches dgos!

pa_scenario_qa_pairs.question: GST filing-gi dus-tshod slebs-song-nga?
pa_scenario_qa_pairs.answer: Jullay, dus-tshod slebs slebs-la yod. Mjug-gi nyin-mo snyog-mo yong-ches bas-na, de-ring thams-cad grub-ches phan!

pa_scenario_qa_pairs.question: De-ring market-ki gnas-tshul ci-zhig yod?
pa_scenario_qa_pairs.answer: De-ring market jang-khu yod! Khyog-gi defense shares-gun rab-mo yod. Snying-rus bcos-ste sgug, phan-thogs yong!

pa_scenario_qa_pairs.question: Doctor-la mjal-ches dus-tshod nam yod?
pa_scenario_qa_pairs.answer: Thore phyi-thok chosting 5 la doctor-la mjal-ches dus-tshod slebs. Leh-ki traffic bas-na khara snga-mo thon-na bzang!

pa_scenario_qa_pairs.question: Thore Iche-yi skyes-skar yod, nga-la dran bcos.
pa_scenario_qa_pairs.answer: Jullay, thore Iche-yi skyes-skar yod, nga dran bcos. Iche-la Jullay zhus dang mngar-mo khyer-ste song!

pa_scenario_qa_pairs.question: Market-la 'gro-ches yod, list ci-zhig yod?
pa_scenario_qa_pairs.answer: O-ma, sgacha, chini dang thar-mo tshas. Lam-la khambu bzang-mo thob-na khyer-ste sho!

pa_scenario_qa_pairs.question: Chitti, chu thung-ches dus-tshod song-nga?
pa_scenario_qa_pairs.answer: Jullay, las-ka bcos-te chu thung-ches brjed-song. Chu khore-zhig thung dang lus-po-la shugs tong!

pa_scenario_qa_pairs.question: De-ring tshong-khang-gi las-ka ci-zhig song?
pa_scenario_qa_pairs.answer: De-ring tshong rab-mo song! Khwa-nyin bas-na 15% mang-ngu song. List bcos-te yod, da khyog ngal-so mdzod!

pa_scenario_qa_pairs.question: Sngatho-ne gtam-bzang-zhig shod.
pa_scenario_qa_pairs.answer: Jullay! De-ring-gi bsam-lo: 'Snying-rus bcos-na las-ka grub'. Rang-gi nus-pa-la yid-ches bcos, de-ring khyog-gi nyin-mo yin!

address_rules.respect: Always use 'Ley' (གླེ) as a suffix for respect. Use 'Ache/Cho-cho' for elders. 'Jullay' is essential for greeting.
